text:
```yaml
name: Publish to npm

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js and pnpm
        uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: true
          force-install: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Build package
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: pnpm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
